company.name: Observa
company.shortDescription: AI-powered auditing platform that delivers insights and actions to CPG brands and retailers via data from shelf cameras, robots, and humans.
company.description: Observa is an AI-powered auditing platform that helps CPG brands and brick-and-mortar retailers track the performance of in-store sales and marketing efforts in real-time.  Our platform lets you see what your customers see at the point of purchase.  Actionable insights help you overcome challenges before they negatively affect the bottom line.

productsAndServices.description: A service where field representatives visit stores to capture photos and data on product availability, pricing, facings, and shelf conditions to identify out-of-stocks and execution issues.
productsAndServices.name: Shelf Audit

productsAndServices.description: A platform that uses AI and data to map product categories, monitor competitor performance, and analyze sales drivers by combining shelf and sales data.
productsAndServices.name: Category Intelligence

productsAndServices.description: A fully managed merchandising program that optimizes store visits and merchandising efforts based on sales data to maximize return on investment at the store and SKU level.
productsAndServices.name: ROI-Led Merchandising

productsAndServices.description: A service that collects detailed photos and measurements of store fixtures and layouts to ensure proper signage placement and display installation across retail locations.
productsAndServices.name: Site Survey

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Convertible note round raised $800,000, or 26.01% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,958,509 to $7,454,092, a 1.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 54 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 34 (-16).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
